CL-RECURSION-04:
n=int(input());mask=(1<<n)-1
def dfs(cols,left,right):
 if cols==mask:return 1
 free=mask&~(cols|left|right);ans=0
 while free:
  bit=free&-free;free-=bit;ans+=dfs(cols|bit,(left|bit)<<1,(right|bit)>>1)
 return ans
print(dfs(0,0,0))
